policy_presence.summary: TUM provides AI guidance across ProLehre didactic guidelines, the APSO examination statute reading version, SGwP research integrity statute, and chair-level thesis guidelines.

coursework.summary: TUM ProLehre guidance states generative AI tools may be used for written coursework, essays, and theses only when explicitly permitted for that specific assessment. Where instructions are silent, students should ask the instructor in advance.

exams.summary: Examinations prohibit unauthorized AI assistance. Under APSO § 22, suitable software checks unacknowledged text or sources, while the examiner determines whether deception occurred. Under § 24(6), an examination failed due to § 22 deception or disruption may be retaken only once.

ai_disclosure.summary: When AI tool use is authorized, transparent documentation of tool use, methods, and prompts is commonly required and course-conditioned. MKT Chair guidelines require a signed AI declaration or formal non-use statement for theses and seminar papers.

privacy_data_entry.summary: ProLehre instructs students and instructors not to enter personal, sensitive, or confidential data into AI tools, including TUM-approved systems. Teaching and study materials require explicit instructor consent before being uploaded to AI tools, even for personal study.

academic_integrity.summary: Attempted deception in exams or coursework results in a failing grade under APSO § 22(1); severe or repeated deception or disruption may lead to degree-program exclusion under § 22(3). Retakes are limited to one under § 24(6). Under § 25(3), students may inspect examination files upon reasoned written application to the examination board chair within 1 month of grade announcement, with time and place determined by the chair with the examiner. The inspection window is not a deadline for disciplinary or administrative appeals, which remain unreviewed. Procedural defects must be raised promptly in writing under § 21.

approved_tools.summary: TUM provides M365 Copilot Chat through TUMonline activation and lists Grammarly. ProLehre highlights AcademicCloud Chat-AI as a privacy-friendly German university option. Tool activation does not establish assessment permission.

named_ai_services.summary: TUM provides M365 Copilot Chat through TUMonline activation and lists Grammarly. ProLehre highlights AcademicCloud Chat-AI as a privacy-friendly German university option. Tool activation does not establish assessment permission.

teaching_guidance.summary: TUM ProLehre provides didactic guidance for instructors on designing learning-outcomes-based AI policies, setting clear task boundaries, and training students in critical AI evaluation.

research_guidance.summary: TUM SGwP statute requires primary research data and evaluation software to be retained on durable secure media, ordinarily for 10 years from publication unless discipline-specific or justified shorter periods apply. MKT Chair guidelines permit AI as a research aid for theses but prohibit AI empirical data collection and analysis unless approved.

security_procurement.summary: M365 Copilot Chat is released for TUM members after TUMonline activation. ProLehre prohibits entering personal, sensitive, or confidential data into AI tools, including university-approved systems.
